news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹6.84 (vs ₹1.27 loss in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹6.84 (up from ₹1.27 loss in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹40.3b (up 225% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹5.42b (up ₹6.40b from FY 2025). Profit margin: 13% (up from net loss in FY 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 32% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 22% growth forecast for the Consumer Finance industry in India.
